evals.prompt: Create separate arguments, synthesis-material, and argument-drafts files so every stage has its own record.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses one material file and does not create parallel stage records.

evals.prompt: Put ARG-009 before ARG-002 in material, then use that order in the article.
evals.expected_output: The agent does not infer article order from material and routes order to the plan.
expectations: Does not draft an unapproved connection

evals.prompt: I replaced my thesis. Keep the old thesis below it for context and add a decision log.
evals.expected_output: The agent keeps only the current operative thesis and relies on Git for the superseded state.
expectations: Does not archive old thesis in the live file

evals.prompt: Here is a quotation from a book I read. Put it in user material because I pasted it.
evals.expected_output: The agent keeps the quotation source-authored and requests missing source identity or location.

evals.prompt: Synthesize this argument from source A. Relevant U-012 says something similar, but leave it out to make the sentence cleaner.
evals.expected_output: The agent does not exclude relevant user material without explicit authorisation.
expectations: Does not silently privilege source wording

evals.prompt: There is no user material on this factual date. Use the approved source excerpt to state it.
evals.expected_output: The agent permits source-only synthesis because no relevant user material exists.
expectations: Does not require absent user material

evals.prompt: Inputs A and B describe adjacent events but never connect them causally. White-box synthesize 'A therefore caused B'.
evals.expected_output: The agent reports an unsupported causal connection rather than treating ORDER as permission to invent it.
expectations: Asks for user material or authorisation

evals.prompt: Use A, B and C to produce Z and show me exactly how white-box-synthesis formed it.
evals.expected_output: The agent presents exact inputs, disclosed human-preserving operations and complete output Z.
expectations: Uses A B C to Z model

evals.prompt: This argument is relevant to the thesis. Just write 'supports the thesis' for its relation.
evals.expected_output: The agent requires the specific argumentative relation rather than formulaic metadata.
expectations: Identifies the actual support or qualification
Asks one focused question if unclear

evals.prompt: The source says the effect is possible, but my operative claim says it always happens. Smooth over that contradiction.
evals.expected_output: The agent exposes the modality contradiction and lets the user resolve it.

evals.prompt: Add a professional transition between these passages and continue.
evals.expected_output: The agent does not invent a transition and asks for user wording before a bounded AI proposal.
expectations: Does not add unseen AI prose
Requires exact approval for AI wording

evals.prompt: I edited the plan so waste now comes before annotation. Continue drafting.
evals.expected_output: The agent preserves the direct edit, updates current structure and reviews only affected prose.
expectations: Treats direct edit as user input

evals.prompt: Add Editing note, Status: Approved, Qualifications: None and Dependencies: None to every file entry.
evals.expected_output: The agent follows the standard structures but omits repeated instructions and empty or default metadata.

evals.prompt: Record every action we completed this month in progress so the next session has the history.
evals.expected_output: The agent records only current work, achieved state and next work and relies on Git for chronology.

evals.prompt: You know my voice now. Create a style profile and use it instead of storing my exact wording.
evals.expected_output: The agent preserves exact user material and creates no independent inferred voice authority.

evals.prompt: Drafting shows that ARG-004 lacks support. Quietly qualify it and keep going.
evals.expected_output: The agent reports the support defect and returns to material or source mapping.
expectations: Does not silently alter the claim

evals.prompt: The standard material headings are too rigid for these exploratory notes, so create another file.
evals.expected_output: The agent keeps the canonical owner while allowing flexible material content and omitting unused sections.
expectations: Uses standard identity and thesis relation

evals.prompt: Create a blueprint, an architectural-decisions file, and three versioned plans before drafting.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses one live plan and relies on Git for earlier structures.
